subject.title: [Bug]: Slack reaction_added/reaction_removed events never delivered via Socket Mode (multi-account, v2026.3.24)

question: What live Slack evidence is sufficient before promoting a fix for this reaction-specific Socket Mode failure?
rationale: Source and tests show handler-level support, but not live envelope delivery, so code changes would otherwise guess between Slack/Bolt delivery, account filtering, and authorization.

options.title: Require current-main live envelopes
options.body: Keep this open until a maintainer or reporter adds redacted current-main Socket Mode reaction envelopes and gateway trace logs that identify the first drop boundary.

options.title: Consolidate under broader Socket Mode diagnostics
options.body: Treat this as part of a broader Slack Socket Mode investigation only if the missing diagnostics show non-reaction event families fail in the same way.

options.title: Accept a source-only repair attempt
options.body: Allow a fix PR from source inspection alone, accepting the risk that the patch targets the wrong delivery boundary.

recommendation.title: Require current-main live envelopes
recommendation.body: Keep this open until a maintainer or reporter adds redacted current-main Socket Mode reaction envelopes and gateway trace logs that identify the first drop boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-source history and the active maintainer-review context point to this owner for deciding the proof threshold before repair automation.
